title: infra_migration_worklist
description: The worklist of a 1.1.1 to 1.2.0 migration, kept in spec/extras/migration/worklist.json: one item per decision a migration script could not make. The scripts add items (migration/worklist.py); a person closes one by setting resolved to true and writing a note. Committed and tool-owned; not a step artifact and not read by the graph.

items.description: The items, in the order step, kind, id.

id.description: wl-<step>-<kind>-<slug of about and key>; the same case always gets the same id, so a rerun adds nothing twice.

step.description: The step the decision belongs to: 00 to 15 with 02a and 13a, or 16.

kind.description: A kebab-case name of the sort of decision (status-conflict, scope-reason, ...).

audience.description: agent: an agent proposes in the step pass and a person confirms; operator: a person decides.

blocking.description: A display hint (sort order and wording on the triage list). Nothing gates on it.

about.description: The node id or the spec file path the case is about.

proposal.description: What the script would do; empty when it has no proposal.

resolved.description: True once a person has settled the item. A rerun never reopens it.

note.description: What was decided (empty while the item is open).
